messages:
Liam (Support): Escalation: Zenith trial tenant zen-trial-21 seeing persistent embed timeouts during a bulk import. Customer demo tomorrow; they said they'll freeze pilot if not resolved in 48h. @Priya can CS take lead? :rotating_light:
Priya (CSM): I'm on it. Liam, paste console alerts + any SDK flags they toggled.
Liam (Support): Console shows quota_exceeded spikes. Sample:

```
2026-06-11T07:22:10Z ERROR embed-service tenant=zen-trial-21 rate=840/s limit=500/s quota_exceeded
2026-06-11T07:22:12Z ERROR client sdk timeout request_id=zzx111
```

Liam (Support): They set "concurrency=14" in their ingestion tool yesterday while ramping.
Hannah (CS): Risk summary: stalled onboarding -> failed demo -> renewal pressure. Proposed plan: 1) immediate acknowledgement + ETA, 2) schedule 30m triage with eng within 4h, 3) temporary uplift + smoothing for demo window, 4) enablement session on batching and SDK defaults, 5) capture product feedback on SDK defaults and console alerts. Priya, you good to own external comms?
Priya (CSM): Yes, I'll own comms and the enablement. Draft external message (keeps infra light):

"Hi Zenith team 1  thanks for reporting this. We're investigating a throttling issue affecting embed requests during your recent import which is impacting demos. We have scheduled a troubleshooting session with our engineers and will temporarily raise throughput while we stabilize. We'll also offer a short enablement on batching and SDK settings. Meeting invite incoming.  Priya, CSM"

Marco (Engineer): Likely cause: client concurrency spikes exhausted per-tenant burst credits; embed cluster in us-west-2 operating near capacity. Short-term: bump soft limit to 1100/s for 12-24h and enable request smoothing; monitor closely. Mid-term: recommend client batching, SDK backoff defaults, and autoscale adjustments. I'll prepare the uplift command and monitoring query; will execute only after verbal ack on the call.
Tess (RevOps): If mitigation extends beyond 24h, ping me and I'll open a renewal-watch and prep AE outreach. Consider offering a demo credit if we can't restore their demo on time.
ops-bot: [meeting] Created incident-zenith-1791239999 meeting at 2026-06-11T09:30:00Z; attendees: Priya, Marco, Liam, Hannah
Liam (Support): Customer replied: "Thanks, we'll join the call at 09:30. Please uplift if possible for our demo."
Priya (CSM): Action items: - Priya: send acknowledgement (doing now) and run enablement. - Marco: prep uplift command + dashboards. - Liam: collect SDK change details and failed request traces. - Hannah: prep AE/RevOps note if >24h.
Marco (Engineer): Uplift preview (for call):

```
# preview only
PATCH /internal/quotas/tenants/zen-trial-21 { "soft_limit": 1100 }
# monitor: GET /metrics?tenant=zen-trial-21&window=5m
```

Marco (Engineer): Will post the exact CLI on the call and await verbal confirmation. Rollback to 500/s after 24h unless a longer-term commit is agreed.
Hannah (CS): Reminder: keep external comms simple and avoid infra specifics. We'll only surface technical details if the customer asks.
Tess (RevOps): Standby. If we hit 24h, I'll create the renewal-watch and loop in AE.
Priya (CSM): Thanks team. After resolution I'll attach the RCA, enablement recording, and prevention checklist to the account record and update account health. :thumbsup:
Liam (Support): -- end thread --
